findings: 主结果仅为同一 RTX 4090 上固定 cuPQC 0.4.1 配置 (BlockDim=128、单流) 的设备驻留计时；6 对进程重复、每进程 15 次、5 次预热、每格仅 1 个固定输入集。未报告推断性 95% CI，进程对最小/最大倍数不是置信区间。
历史 R02 的 27 格约 1.695011 倍与此处 10/18 重建实验是不同来源；本包的 historical 目录只是历史再导出，不能重复计入 5090 旧包中的同源数据。
cuDilithium vs CCS 基线包含 54 实现格、27 比较格、162 对、324 操作进程均值及 4860 原始样本，属于 legacy Dilithium v3.1，不是 FIPS 204 ML-DSA。Host API 含传输计时不得与主结果设备驻留时间直接相除。
正确性补实验最终 24 例 x memcheck/initcheck/synccheck =72 进程，复用 59 + 新增 13，报告错误为 0。无 racecheck 声明；32字节消息/空上下文/固定语料不构成完整 KAT 或 FIPS 认证。
边界测试 270 进程（48 KeyGen、222 Verify）通过，边界时间仅诊断用途；原小批检查为 21 例、171 检查项：149 PASS、18 NOT_AVAILABLE、4 SKIPPED。
阶段追踪为 27 格、81 进程、1215 个计量区间、14490 次内核启动；为 CUPTI 插桩诊断，不是正常发布性能。39 进程早期完成、42 进程恢复完成，不是一个连续采样窗口。
ML-DSA-44 Verify 零拷贝消融为 3 格，B8192 的源路径预期不激活；不能将该格约 1.0006 倍描述为零拷贝收益。ML-DSA-65 Verify 提前拒绝消融为 36 格，OFF/ON 范围 0.9935375–4.1499497 倍；最大值来自 B16384 全部 invalid-z。
Verify traffic 62 格保留一个计时尖峰；3 格重查另存，尖峰原因未证实，不自动替换或删除旧值。
资源分析 81 进程、321 个选定热点启动、81 格符号统计；workspace 27 格/81进程，区分需求容量、实际容量、计量区间存活峰值及 fixture 缓冲；不包含驱动、上下文等全部显存。
Sign retry 9 格/27 进程，258048 请求运行记录和258048 winner记录已在归档已有验收中复核；诊断插桩，44/87 为源代码推导顺序证书，65 为观测开始次数，不可混用作同一吞吐指标。
SHAKE 9 参数-批量格，342 变体格/15390计时；NTT 9 参数-批量格，162 变体格/7290计时。两者均独立算子测试；SHAKE 没有 split32/独立 ballot compaction，NTT 没有独立 Shuffle/完整 KeyGen-Sign-Verify 链，不能声称全生产链加速。
失败和部分完成保留：correctness 因 GPU_BUSY_POST 中断后续跑完成；resources V1 NCU 参数错误且零接受进程，V2完成；sign retry V2 AUDIT exit2 且零接受进程，V3完成；stage初版失败后V2恢复完成；trace probe V1缺标记，V2通过。测试桩 QA PASS 与实际设备测试分开。
很多原始 IO / ELF 未返还，只可核对服务器留存哈希和已有验收。当前工作独立读表、核对选择规则及算术汇总，没有重跑GPU、独立密码学验证或复核每一份服务器审计。
独立重算主实验 4860 条与重测 540 条原始计时：27 原格 +3 重测格的均值及6进程对几何均值全部在 1e-12 容差内吻合。跨旧包历史表匹配确认其为再导出，GPU UUID 匿名化不构成新的实验。

quality.limitation: Standalone sealed donor arithmetic operators, not complete production API/module speedups.
Each batch counts output polynomials. Chain computes sum over L polynomial products (L=4/5/7); no SHAKE, decomposition or full matrix-vector K rows.
Split chain includes two batched forward kernels, a pointwise dot kernel and inverse kernel. Fused chain uses one kernel; identical inputs and modular outputs.
All backends accept canonical int32 input and produce canonical int32 output. Tensor timing includes byte packing, WMMA layout adaptation and output normalization.
Inverse output uses R/256 normalization (invntt_tomont). Pointwise uses Montgomery R^-1, so complete chains output ordinary negacyclic products.
512 deterministic request rows include all 256 basis directions and random/edge data; rows are tiled across batches and reused by three processes.
All variants qualify before any formal timing. Every coefficient is checked initially and finally; individual timed intermediate outputs are not separately checked.
Raw CUDA-event timing excludes allocation, CPU reference work, and host/device transfers; includes all split launches and wrapper operations.
Shared lock and pre/post GPU idle samples are used; continuous exclusive GPU ownership is not established.
Local CPU tests cannot establish CUDA compilation/device correctness. Server build and every correctness check must pass before acceptance.
Three process repeats reuse 512 deterministic corpus rows tiled into all batch sizes.
Fused/split comparison also changes parallelization and storage, so its ratio is not solely the launch-overhead contribution.
Archive originally had no downloaded SHA sidecar; the reported SHA256 is computed from the current local file, while each member is verified against the included manifest.
Standalone operators using sealed donor Keccak and scalar-comparator sources; original nine DSOs are neither modified nor loaded.
Sampling uses the same lane-zero parser in both backends; this isolates Keccak state mapping, not ballot-compaction performance.
Kernel event times include output initialization, decoding and trace writes; no end-to-end production-module speedup is established.
ON/OFF changes this audit harness only. OFF uses eight squeeze blocks, rather than a production-module early-stop configuration.
Forced-rejection cases are synthetic refill/exhaustion fixtures, not normal FIPS vectors.
256 deterministic input rows are tiled across each batch; empty-input SHAKE has one unique row. Three processes reuse the same corpus.
All requests/bytes and counters are checked before and after each timed variant; individual intermediate timed outputs are not separately checked.
Shared stage lock and pre/post idle GPU samples are used; continuous exclusive GPU use is not claimed.
CPU-only self-tests do not establish CUDA compilation or device correctness; those must pass on the server before acceptance.
Original raw input/output remain on server; this review verifies their retained hashes, not omitted bytes.
Instrumentation is diagnostic and does not establish formal release timing.
ML-DSA-44/87 evaluations are source-derived sequential certificates; ML-DSA-65 counts observed starts.
Three process repeats use the same fixed input corpus.
The parent verified the archive SHA and safely extracted it; this audit independently rehashed every included file but did not reread the compressed archive.

270 raw process input.bin copies are omitted. Their hash/size records match the process artifact facts, validation input facts, and independently prepared CPU input metadata; omitted bytes cannot be locally rehashed.

The 48 raw corpus.bin envelopes, 270 packed CPU inputs and CPU verifier binary are intentionally excluded from the returned archive; their recorded identities and source metadata were crosschecked, not their raw bytes.
Recorded CPU oracle execution and returned reference vectors are evidence; this inventory audit does not rerun PQMagic or GPU kernels.
Fixed-prefix corpora, empty context and 32-byte messages do not establish independent-dataset generalization, Sign tail support, sampler exhaustion, sanitizer coverage or full FIPS conformance.
GPU ownership is assessed in the separate boundary_monitor_detail_review.json; process snapshots cannot establish uninterrupted exclusivity.
Raw corpus and packed/process inputs remain on server; returned reference and GPU output bytes checked locally.

No Sign/KAT/FIPS/sampler exhaustion/exception recovery/sanitizer coverage is inferred.
Raw process IO and original ELF binaries remain server-side; local checks establish retained metadata and hash linkage, not a new cryptographic verification of omitted raw bytes.
A single deterministic input family and three process blocks are covered; final output per process is checked, not every intermediate timing iteration.
HOST_API_INTERVAL_NO_REFERENCE is a warm per-call host interval including invoke and synchronization, excluding loading, initialization and CPU reference work.
Host/device paths have different buffer-residency contracts. Their ratio is neither isolated transfer overhead nor full application end-to-end cost.

CPU expectations reuse sealed PQMagic 4096-row corpora, prefixing each SoA field separately. KeyGen and Verify are recomputed with the sealed PQMagic library; Sign bytes reuse its retained CPU oracle.
Inputs have 32-byte messages, empty context, and fixed retained randomness. This is not full KAT/FIPS certification, a second independent implementation, or arbitrary-message coverage.
MLDNAT02 attempt/kappa/digest fields are zero transport placeholders, unused for selection/retry; this is not a measured natural-retry corpus.
Two invalid CLI calls must return a specific error before a later independent valid process. This is process-level continuation, not in-process recovery or fault-injection coverage.
Instrumentation timings are retained only for diagnosis and must not be used for performance/speedup claims.
The shared stage lock and idle samples prevent cooperating experiments from overlapping; continuous exclusive GPU ownership is not established.
A sanitizer finding or missing tool stops the matrix and preserves a failure archive. Local CPU QA does not establish server tool availability or CUDA execution success.
Standalone sealed donor arithmetic operators, not complete production API/module speedups.
Each batch counts output polynomials. Chain computes sum over L polynomial products (L=4/5/7); no SHAKE, decomposition or full matrix-vector K rows.
Split chain includes two batched forward kernels, a pointwise dot kernel and inverse kernel. Fused chain uses one kernel; identical inputs and modular outputs.
All backends accept canonical int32 input and produce canonical int32 output. Tensor timing includes byte packing, WMMA layout adaptation and output normalization.
Inverse output uses R/256 normalization (invntt_tomont). Pointwise uses Montgomery R^-1, so complete chains output ordinary negacyclic products.
512 deterministic request rows include all 256 basis directions and random/edge data; rows are tiled across batches and reused by three processes.
All variants qualify before any formal timing. Every coefficient is checked initially and finally; individual timed intermediate outputs are not separately checked.
Raw CUDA-event timing excludes allocation, CPU reference work, and host/device transfers; includes all split launches and wrapper operations.
Shared lock and pre/post GPU idle samples are used; continuous exclusive GPU ownership is not established.
Local CPU tests cannot establish CUDA compilation/device correctness. Server build and every correctness check must pass before acceptance.

key_findings: 主结果仅为同一 RTX 4090 上固定 cuPQC 0.4.1 配置 (BlockDim=128、单流) 的设备驻留计时；6 对进程重复、每进程 15 次、5 次预热、每格仅 1 个固定输入集。未报告推断性 95% CI，进程对最小/最大倍数不是置信区间。
历史 R02 的 27 格约 1.695011 倍与此处 10/18 重建实验是不同来源；本包的 historical 目录只是历史再导出，不能重复计入 5090 旧包中的同源数据。
cuDilithium vs CCS 基线包含 54 实现格、27 比较格、162 对、324 操作进程均值及 4860 原始样本，属于 legacy Dilithium v3.1，不是 FIPS 204 ML-DSA。Host API 含传输计时不得与主结果设备驻留时间直接相除。
正确性补实验最终 24 例 x memcheck/initcheck/synccheck =72 进程，复用 59 + 新增 13，报告错误为 0。无 racecheck 声明；32字节消息/空上下文/固定语料不构成完整 KAT 或 FIPS 认证。
边界测试 270 进程（48 KeyGen、222 Verify）通过，边界时间仅诊断用途；原小批检查为 21 例、171 检查项：149 PASS、18 NOT_AVAILABLE、4 SKIPPED。
阶段追踪为 27 格、81 进程、1215 个计量区间、14490 次内核启动；为 CUPTI 插桩诊断，不是正常发布性能。39 进程早期完成、42 进程恢复完成，不是一个连续采样窗口。
ML-DSA-44 Verify 零拷贝消融为 3 格，B8192 的源路径预期不激活；不能将该格约 1.0006 倍描述为零拷贝收益。ML-DSA-65 Verify 提前拒绝消融为 36 格，OFF/ON 范围 0.9935375–4.1499497 倍；最大值来自 B16384 全部 invalid-z。
Verify traffic 62 格保留一个计时尖峰；3 格重查另存，尖峰原因未证实，不自动替换或删除旧值。
资源分析 81 进程、321 个选定热点启动、81 格符号统计；workspace 27 格/81进程，区分需求容量、实际容量、计量区间存活峰值及 fixture 缓冲；不包含驱动、上下文等全部显存。
Sign retry 9 格/27 进程，258048 请求运行记录和258048 winner记录已在归档已有验收中复核；诊断插桩，44/87 为源代码推导顺序证书，65 为观测开始次数，不可混用作同一吞吐指标。
SHAKE 9 参数-批量格，342 变体格/15390计时；NTT 9 参数-批量格，162 变体格/7290计时。两者均独立算子测试；SHAKE 没有 split32/独立 ballot compaction，NTT 没有独立 Shuffle/完整 KeyGen-Sign-Verify 链，不能声称全生产链加速。
失败和部分完成保留：correctness 因 GPU_BUSY_POST 中断后续跑完成；resources V1 NCU 参数错误且零接受进程，V2完成；sign retry V2 AUDIT exit2 且零接受进程，V3完成；stage初版失败后V2恢复完成；trace probe V1缺标记，V2通过。测试桩 QA PASS 与实际设备测试分开。
很多原始 IO / ELF 未返还，只可核对服务器留存哈希和已有验收。当前工作独立读表、核对选择规则及算术汇总，没有重跑GPU、独立密码学验证或复核每一份服务器审计。
独立重算主实验 4860 条与重测 540 条原始计时：27 原格 +3 重测格的均值及6进程对几何均值全部在 1e-12 容差内吻合。跨旧包历史表匹配确认其为再导出，GPU UUID 匿名化不构成新的实验。
